verdicts.reason: A scatters the flavour pills out of order (Honey Rosemary first, Cucumber Mint off to the right on the pink circle, Blood Orange stranded below), squeezes the subtitle into a narrow three-line column beside the CTA, and crowds the lower half. B keeps the headline → subtitle → CTA reading order and the pill sequence, but the pills are as heavy as the CTA and compete with it, the subtitle is tiny, and the off-centre CTA with the staggered pill rows gives an uneven, bottom-heavy grid.
